title: Phase 1 Study to Assess the Safety and Tolerability of TAT4 Gel in Healthy Volunteers
brief_summary: This Phase 1, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, healthy volunteer study tested the safety, tolerability, and plasma pharmacokinetics of two different concentrations of TAT4 Gel administered once daily to 50 cm2 of skin for 14 days.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men and women 40-70 years old
* Healthy volunteers
* Provision of informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of skin hypersensitivity
* Abnormality on screening assessments
